skills.description: This skill should be used when the user (a publisher editor or content director) needs to optimize a basic book topic proposal / topic report into a professional, market-driven, high-value topic plan. Triggers include: 编辑提供的基础版选题策划方案、选题报告、新书策划案、选题方向、立项报告需要深度优化. The skill performs multi-dimensional analysis (4P/4C/STP/SWOT/3C/PEST/波特五力) covering product positioning, content value, author background, competitor benchmarking (开卷数据/同类对标书), reader profiling, marketing strategy, book format suggestions (开本/页数/定价), and sales forecasting. Output: a comprehensive topic optimization report in both Markdown and Word (.docx) formats. Built for Beijing Yilin Lishi Media (北京意林励志传媒) which publishes middle/primary school 大语文 extracurricular readers and supplementary textbooks (教辅), but the methodology generalizes to any K12 阅读/教辅 product line.

skills.name: 图书选题策划与优化
